Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Clothes & getting dressed

zip noun

also zipper

modern

Traupman 118, 410

clausūra tractilis

Examples

  • Clausūram tractilem sūrsum trahe.

    Pull the zip up.composed

  • Pater puerō dormientī, antequam ex āëroplanō ēgrederentur, paenulam induit, clausūrā tractilī clausit, pilleum imposuit.

    Before they got off the plane, Dad put the sleeping boy’s coat on, zipped it up and put on his cap.composed

See also button up, coat.

SourcesLewis & Short: clausura · Lewis & Short: tractilis

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 118.

The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
